facts.text: JMU's Centennial Scholars Program provides financial support to help cover primary attendance costs, including tuition and fees, housing, and a meal plan.
All incoming JMU students complete an online training in the Eight Key Questions, the university's signature ethical reasoning framework.

facts.text: Students who complete the Valley Scholars program receive four-year scholarships to JMU that cover full tuition and fees.
